Article 4.1: The Exhibition Stage (OG Accounts Only)

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule

OG accounts are no longer sold. Existing OG accounts keep their rules.

What Is the Exhibition Stage?

The Exhibition stage is an intermediate phase between passing the evaluation and receiving a sim-funded account. It applies ONLY to Standard OG and Express OG accounts. MAX accounts do not have an Exhibition stage.

Purpose of Exhibition

The Exhibition account allows traders to build a profit buffer equal to the account's drawdown amount. This buffer rolls over into the funded account and becomes the starting equity above the original balance.

Exhibition Goals and Rules
You must build a buffer equal to the account's drawdown amount (see table below).
You must stay within the 40% consistency rule during Exhibition.
T1 news trading is PROHIBITED. Violation results in immediate account liquidation and forfeiture of all profits.
All standard trading hour rules apply (flat by 4:50 PM EST, etc.)
The trailing drawdown is the same type as the evaluation for that account type.
Exhibition Buffer Targets (OG Accounts: All Sizes)
Account Size	Exhibition Buffer Target	Funded Account Starting Balance
$25,000	$1,500	$26,500
$50,000	$2,000	$52,000
$100,000	$3,600	$103,600
$150,000	$5,000	$155,000
$250,000	$6,000	$256,000
NOTE: These exhibition buffer amounts are what rolls into your funded account. Traders promoted to the FFN Institution start with $3,000 of real FFN capital, and simulated balances do not transfer (see Article 4.3). The funded account starting balance equals Account Size + Buffer Amount.
What Happens After Exhibition?
You reach the buffer target while staying within consistency.
Your Exhibition account is reviewed by FFN.
A funded (Sim-Funded Pro) account is set up, taking 2–7 business days.
Your funded account starts at Account Size + Buffer (e.g., $52,000 for a 50K account).
The drawdown becomes Static +$100 in the funded account.
Exhibition Reset Option

If you fail the Exhibition account (breach the trailing drawdown), you have two options:

Reset the Exhibition account (pay the reset fee; see below). You have 7 trading days from the failure to choose this option.
Restart the entire Evaluation process (buy a new evaluation account).
Exhibition Reset Fees
Account Size	Exhibition Reset Fee
$25,000	$312.50
$50,000	$625.00
$100,000	$1,250.00
$150,000	$1,875.00
$250,000	$3,125.00

Q: How long do I have to reset an exhibition account after failing?

A: You have 7 trading days from the date of failure to pay the reset fee and continue. After 7 days, this option expires and you must restart the evaluation.

Q: Does the exhibition buffer target increase if I breach the consistency rule during Exhibition?

A: Yes. In Exhibition, the consistency rule is based on 40% of the buffer target. If one session exceeds 40% of the buffer amount, your buffer target increases to restore consistency.
